descriptionChirho: A pit or hole dug in the ground, including trapping pits and the metaphorical pit of Sheol or death, translated as 'pit' (eng), 'foso/fosa/hoyo' (spa), 'गड्ढा' (hin), 'الجب/الحفرة/الهوة' (arb), '구덩이' (kor), 'shimo' (swa).
A cistern or well used for drawing or storing water, translated as 'cistern/well' (eng), 'cisterna/pozo' (spa), 'कुआँ/कुएँ' (hin), 'بئر' (arb), '우물' (kor), 'kisima/visima' (swa).
Metaphorical use of 'pit' for a prison or dungeon, a place of confinement, translated as 'calabozo' (spa), 'السجن' (arb), '감옥' (kor), 'gereza' (swa).
